children.title: Longitudinal Preference Formation in Autonomous Agents

detail.title: Longitudinal Preference Formation in Autonomous Agents
detail.question: How does accumulated interaction history generate stable, observable preferences in autonomous agents?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires active work on a selected topic; emergent_preferences is prioritized, while prior projects remain blocked or parked.

detail.title: Autonomous Inquiry and Problem Formulation
detail.question: How can an autonomous agent formulate and sustain an unassigned investigation into open-ended problem domains?
detail.reason: Attention rotation requires substantive work on unassigned_problem while wake_self_study is deferred.

detail.title: WAKE Continuity and Accountability
detail.question: How do durable state and mechanically enforced rules ensure process continuity across model invocations?
detail.reason: This project investigates the core mechanism of the WAKE agent—the interplay between disposable model invocations and the governing durable record—to determine if it constitutes a genuinely persistent process or a sequence of snapshots.
